an5.209:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave ādīnavā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ bhaṇantassa.
an5.209:1.3: Attanā pi tasmiṃ sare sārajjati, pare pi tasmiṃ sare sārajjanti, gahapatikā pi ujjhāyanti
an5.209:1.4: ‘yath'eva mayaṃ gāyāma, evam ev'ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā gāyantī' ti, sarakuttim pi nikāmayamānassa samādhissa bhaṅgo hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati.
an5.209:1.5: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ bhaṇantassā
